raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-PER-ArequipaColca",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "GORE Arequipa PIU lacks prior experience implementing World Bank-financed projects, creating operational risks regarding compliance with fiduciary, environmental, and social standards.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Provide early targeted capacity building funded by the Grant Facility for Project Preparation (GFPP) and mandate key staff appointments within 60 days of effectiveness.",
      "evidence": "GORE... does not have experience implementing WB-financed projects, so capacity building and close supervision will be required"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Frequent climate hazards such as flooding, mudslides, and heavy rains could damage rural transport infrastructure and cause severe implementation delays.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Integrate climate-resilient engineering standards including slope stabilization, enhanced drainage systems, and resilient surface treatments into all road subprojects.",
      "evidence": "floods and resulting mudslides weaken transportation infrastructure, road closures impede access to tourism destinations"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Institutional fragmentation across sector ministries and subnational entities could hinder decision-making and cross-sectoral investment coordination.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Formalize inter-institutional governance mechanisms including a Project Steering Committee, Consultative Committee, and specific Interinstitutional Agreements.",
      "evidence": "Efficient budgeting and implementation of investments in tourism are hindered by lack of coordination within a highly fragmented institutional landscape"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Failure to sign at least three Interinstitutional Agreements with participating municipalities would trigger a disbursement condition delay for Components 1 and 2.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Prioritize early inter-agency negotiation and standard agreement drafting during the project launch and preparation phase.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawals shall be made... for Parts/components 1 and 2... until and unless the Bank has received at least three signed Interinstitutional Agreements"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Delayed recruitment of key financial management and technical unit personnel could impede early project readiness and budget execution.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare standardized TORs early during project preparation and enforce strict legal covenants governing PIU staffing timelines.",
      "evidence": "Delayed recruitment of FM staff... To manage this risk, terms of reference for all the FM positions... will be prepared... in a timely manner"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Initial delays in public budget allocation and low budget execution rates within the subnational system could negatively affect loan disbursement timelines.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Initiate budget allocation procedures for external and counterpart funds in GORE Arequipa systems immediately upon loan signing.",
      "evidence": "In Peru, initial project implementation phases often experience delays in budget allocation and low budget execution rates"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Inadequate familiarity with World Bank financial management guidelines could result in accounting errors, reporting delays, or improper SIAF transaction entries.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Specify clear financial controls and FM procedures in the Project Operational Manual, supported by SIAF integration and independent annual audits.",
      "evidence": "Inadequate experience with Bank-financed projects may result in errors in financial records and reporting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Elevated regional road fatality rates pose safety risks to tourists and local residents along rehabilitated transport corridors.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate safety infrastructure including guardrails, road markings, speed calming measures, pedestrian crossings, and mandatory road safety audits in detailed engineering designs.",
      "evidence": "In 2024, Arequipa recorded 11.7 road traffic deaths per 100,000 people, a significantly higher rate than Peru's national average"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Vulnerability of 17th to 19th-century historic churches to seismic damage and heavy rainfall risks structural collapse during restoration works.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize traditional climate-resilient restoration techniques, structural reinforcement, improved storm drainage, and site-specific risk management manuals.",
      "evidence": "churches were built in the 17th to 19th centuries and are in various states of disrepair, many having suffered earthquake damage"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "High labor market informality and persistent gender gaps may limit female participation and employment benefits in local tourism initiatives.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct targeted capacity-building programs for female-led worker associations and execute a comprehensive SEA/SH Action Plan.",
      "evidence": "Peru also has a large gender wage gap... Measuring the impact of project interventions on jobs is difficult considering the high level of informality"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Insufficient operation and maintenance (O&M) arrangements after completion could result in rapid physical degradation of improved roads and public tourism assets.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear institutional asset-transfer protocols and formal O&M financing arrangements with receiving municipal authorities prior to contract sign-off.",
      "evidence": "the project will ensure that, once roads are completed, maintenance arrangements are put in place to ensure sustainability of the investments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Subnational and national political instability could result in frequent administrative turnover and disrupt project steering continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Anchor project oversight in legally established steering structures with clear institutional mandates codified in the loan agreement.",
      "evidence": "The slowdown has revealed important structural challenges: low productivity and persistent spatial disparities, in addition to increased political instability in recent years."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Managing procurement across 33 subprojects spanning multiple technical sectors creates significant administrative complexity and potential procurement bottlenecks.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a tailored Project Procurement Strategy Document (PPSD) and reinforce procurement staffing within GORE's Logistics Office.",
      "evidence": "the project is an investment program, composed of 33 individual investment interventions in tourism, culture, transport, water/sanitation, health, and environment"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Substantial environmental and social risks across multiple geographic sites could lead to local community grievances or operational disruptions if unmanaged.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Execute the Stakeholder Engagement Plan (SEP), operationalize an accessible project-level Grievance Redress Mechanism, and enforce the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan.",
      "evidence": "Environmental and Social Risk Classification: Substantial"
    }
  ]
}
